Name: Wax Seal for Letter Notifications
Author: bunniemoth
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]Are you keen on a level of hyper-detailed and weirdly-specific granularity in your aesthetic play? Does the naked letter notification make you a little sad that no one in Pelican Town loves stationery as much as you do? Did you search high and low for a wax blob in every other UI mod and finally, upon finding no solution, yell into the Void, “Fine! I’ll do it myself!”, and proceed to make your own because you needed a tiny dot of colour to appear where there was none before that wouldn’t force you to swap out your preferred interface mod? [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Yeah. Well. Guilty as charged.

(Hi, I’m moth. Nice ta meecha.)[/color]


[center][color=#D4D4D8][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/vZRbc1Cf/what-it-is.png[/img][/b][/color][/center]

[color=#d4d4d8]Wax Seal allows you to add a daub of wax to the letter notification that appears above your Farmhouse and Ginger Island mailboxes. Using GMCM, you can select the colour of wax you want. It does not affect the letter presentation in your collections when you open your correspondence — it appears only on the notification.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]You can choose from twenty colours out of four style families, and two paper types* (please see below for parchment instructions):[/color]

[list]

[*]Green[/*]

[*]Red[/*]
[*]Yellow[/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#f9cb9c]Metallics[/color][/b]
[list]

[*]Silver[/*]
[/list]

[list]

[*]Lavender[/*]

[/list]

[/list]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/xjxdT10f/setting-it-up.png[/img]
[/center]

The wax colour defaults to vanilla red, but upon saving out for the day after adding the mod, a config will be generated and you can change it to whichever colour you like.
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Note: [/b]The wax colour will be consistent across any farm location that has a mailbox: one wax blob to rule them all.[/color]


[center][color=#D4D4D8][img]https://i.postimg.cc/3N4Qw7B0/parchment-variant.png[/img][/color][/center]

[left][color=#d4d4d8]If you prefer a vintage paper colour that nurtures your antiquarian sensibilities and appreciation for the musty haze and soft light of old libraries, oiled leather armchairs, the scent of dusty paper clinging to your ink-stained fingertips... there’s a parchment variation in the optional files. [/color][/left]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b]How to: [/b]Select EITHER the Vanilla Paper variant or the Parchment Paper Variant in the downloads and install the paper type of your choosing. Activate either vanilla OR parchment, NOT both.[/color]



[center][color=#D4D4D8][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/7LmFMbtq/faq.png[/img][/b][/color][/center]
[center][/center]

[b][color=#f9cb9c]My wax seal isn’t showing up. Why?[/color][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8]You may be using an interface mod that overwrites the cursors sprite sheet, specifically the letter item. Alternately, another mod may be competing for priority with this one. (See the above note about only installing one paper type.)[/color]

[b][color=#f9cb9c]Where is XYZ colour in the list?[/color][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8]Colours are listed in GMCM alphabetically and not by family.[/color]

[b][color=#f9cb9c]Did you use AI in any part of this mod, its construction, description, banner, etc.?[/color][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8]No. [/color]

[b][color=#f9cb9c]But what about...[/color][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8]The fonts used in the banner are [/color][url=https://www.1001fonts.com/pixelitta-font.html][color=#d4d4d8]Pixelitta[/color][/url][color=#d4d4d8] and [/color][url=https://www.dafont.com/silkscreen.font][color=#d4d4d8]Silkscreen[/color][/url][color=#d4d4d8]. The effects were added as blending options in Photoshop without the use of generative tools. [/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Regarding the yap: you, too, can write like a flowery mf if you pretend to channel Elliott and are currently running on three hours of sleep while you should be getting ready for your city’s comic con, but are instead determined to get the mod that’s been on your hard disk for a month out the door instead, because to-do list Xs are free dopamine! [/color]

[b][color=#f9cb9c]To that ends...[/color][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8]I wholly condemn the use of generative AI. If you’d like to offer a translation of this mod, shoot me a note in the comments and let me know what you’re up to. Please don’t feed my stuff to an LLM. Please do not use AI for any part of your translations or promotional imagery when associated with my mods. I could care less how small or how large the original mod is: keep it human.[/color]
